name: Lebanon
tagline: Universities in Beirut and across Lebanon; most teach in English, some in French or Arabic
summary: Several Lebanese universities use the American system and teach in English, but IB Diploma holders usually need Lebanese education ministry (MEHE) equivalence and enter the sophomore (first-year) class. Entrance exams and SAT scores are common.
whyConsider: American-style credit degrees in English at AUB, NDU and BAU, with published entrance exams and English tests.
watchOuts: Check whether your school certificate needs MEHE equivalence before you apply.
Law, Mass Communication and Psychology at BAU are taught in Arabic; Saint Joseph University mainly teaches in French.
Fees are often in USD and LBP; 2027-28 prices are not published for most schools.
Lebanese American University, University of Balamand and Saint Joseph University are still outline-only: their pages could not be read.
